label: Active market
description: Only enabled transactions participate in the conversion graph.

label: Nonpositive output
description: A transaction whose fee consumes its output cannot advance a cycle.

label: Closed currency path
description: The route returns to its starting currency without revisiting another item.

label: Whole execution batches
description: Use the smallest exact batch that permits whole executions at every step.

label: Fee accounting
description: Subtract the output-denominated fee on every transaction execution.

label: Positive return
description: Final currency exceeds initial currency after modeled fees.

label: Break-even path
description: The route returns exactly the currency it consumes.

label: Loss-making path
description: The route returns less currency than it consumes.

label: No execution caps
description: Every transaction explicitly has an unlimited execution cap.

label: Finite execution cap
description: At least one known positive daily cap bounds route throughput.

label: Unknown execution cap
description: An unknown cap prevents a claim that no execution cap exists.

label: No cooldowns
description: Every transaction explicitly has no cooldown.

label: Cooldown bound
description: A positive cooldown bounds the modeled full-day throughput.

label: Unknown cooldown
description: An unknown cooldown prevents a claim that no time limit exists.

label: Per-account allocation
description: A positive account cap applies separately to each account.

label: Shared allocation
description: A positive global cap applies across the modeled market.

label: Transferable allocation
description: A capped account offer with transferable output warrants checking cross-account aggregation.

label: Bound output
description: Nontransferable output weakens the modeled transfer-aggregation hypothesis.

label: Unknown transfer policy
description: Missing transferability on an account-capped offer requires clarification.

label: Intended return
description: All transactions on the route are marked intended.

label: Unintended return
description: At least one route transaction is marked unintended.

label: Unknown design intent
description: A route with unrecorded intent requires design clarification.

label: Conflicting design intent
description: Mixed intended and unintended labels need a route-level design decision.

label: Repeatable profit
description: A profitable unintended route with explicitly absent caps and cooldowns is repeatable within this model.

label: Unbounded intended reward
description: An intended profitable route still needs review when no caps or cooldowns exist.

label: Account allocation risk
description: A profitable account-limited route with transferable output has a potential aggregation risk, not proven unlimited bypass.

label: Bounded arbitrage
description: Known limits bound a profitable unintended route but do not erase its return.

label: Bounded reward exception
description: A fully specified intended route with a finite limit is an intentional reward, subject to its entered bounds.

label: Request missing facts
description: Unresolved limits, transfer policy, or intent keep a route under review.

label: Output fee correction
description: A sufficient terminal-output fee removes positive return for this exact route.

label: Buyback correction
description: Reducing terminal output to its break-even threshold removes positive return without raising entry cost.

label: Limit intervention
description: A positive global cap bounds payout throughput; it does not remove profitable pricing.

label: No modeled profit
description: The bounded search found no positive-return currency route.

label: Large execution batch
description: A minimum batch above one billion currency units needs feasibility review.

label: Search budget reached
description: The search ended at an explicit resource bound; omitted paths are unassessed.
